title: THEY ARE GREAT
text: THEY ARE GREAT. I started buying these in 2015. I purchased my last set in 2016. It is 2020, what does that tell you? I received them in great shape and they are still in great shape. The seals are still holding and I open and close them frequently. I store flour, sugar, cornmeal, beans and anything that I want to. I love these containers. I will buy them again. I am waiting for them to go a little cheaper so I can buy 2 more. I have not experienced any of the problems mentioned and my containers are going strong. I have 8 of them, need an even 10.

product_metadata.title: Snapware 1098437 40 Cup Clear Airtight Food Storage Container With Handle
